ehdSystems.name: Commercial Multi-Wire-to-Ground Mesh Continuous EHD Dehydration Skid (30 kV DC, Positive Corona, 12-Wire Array)
ehdSystems.classification: Continuous Industrial Electrohydrodynamic Dryer (FDA 21 CFR § 117 / cGMP / NFPA 70 Art. 490)
ehdSystems.emitterElectrodeType: High-Tension Stainless Steel Fine Corona Wires (0.2 mm diameter, 12x parallel spans)
ehdSystems.collectorGroundType: Sanitary AISI 316L Stainless Steel Perforated Ground Conveyor Mesh
ehdSystems.description: High-throughput continuous belt dryer employing a 12-wire high-voltage positive corona array positioned above a grounded stainless steel wire conveyor. Generates steady, unipolar ionic wind plumes with drift velocities up to 4.2 m/s that perpendicularly sweep boundary layer moisture from sliced fruits and bioactives without heating.

ehdSystems.name: High-Density Multi-Pin Needle Matrix Array (35 kV DC, Pulsed Negative Corona, 144-Pin Grid)
ehdSystems.classification: Ultra-High Evaporation EHD Accelerator (3-A Sanitary / CE Machinery Directive)
ehdSystems.emitterElectrodeType: Precision Electropolished Tungsten Needle Array (144 emitter pins, 25 mm pitch)
ehdSystems.description: High-flux point-to-plane needle matrix designed for rapid dewatering of dense vegetable and mushroom matrices. Employs microsecond pulsed negative corona producing intense Trichel pulse electron avalanches, yielding higher momentum transfer and a 20% faster drying rate, coupled with integrated catalytic exhaust filtration.

ehdSystems.name: Cleanroom Low-Ozone Blade-to-Conveyor EHD Skid (22 kV DC, Positive Symmetrical Corona, Dual-Knife)
ehdSystems.classification: Pharmaceutical & Biopolymer Thermolabile Dehydrator (ISO Class 7 / cGMP)
ehdSystems.emitterElectrodeType: Micro-Honed Titanium Blade Electrodes (0.1 mm edge radius, continuous span)
ehdSystems.description: Engineered specifically for live probiotic beads, enzyme encapsulations, and delicate anthocyanin berry purees. Operates at optimized sub-breakdown voltage with razor-edged titanium emitters, maintaining ozone generation under 0.03 ppm while accelerating water removal at room temperature (20°C).

ehdSystems.name: Compromised Misaligned Electrode Array with Excessive Standoff Sparking (Dielectric Breakdown Hazard)
ehdSystems.classification: HAZARDOUS / NON-COMPLIANT (Thermal Spark Arcing, Localized Charring & Severe Ozone Infiltration)
ehdSystems.emitterElectrodeType: Corroded & Bent Wire Electrodes with Carbonized Dust Deposits
ehdSystems.dischargeRegime: Uncontrolled Filamentary Spark & Thermal Arc Breakdown
ehdSystems.description: Severely degraded high-voltage drying assembly characterized by dirty emitter wires, improper electrical grounding, and erratic spark discharges. Creates thermal arcs that scorch product edges, destroys ascorbic acid, and emits hazardous levels of ozone and NOx violating OSHA workplace safety standards.

foodSubstrates.name: Sliced Fresh Strawberries (Fragaria × ananassa - High Ascorbic Acid & Anthocyanin)
foodSubstrates.botanicalClass: Soft Rosaceae Fruit (Porous Parenchyma, High Initial Moisture)
foodSubstrates.description: Strawberries are exceptionally sensitive to thermal degradation. Standard hot-air drying at 60°C degrades over 55% of native vitamin C and oxidizes cyanidin/pelargonidin anthocyanins into brown pigments. Non-thermal EHD drying removes moisture via boundary-layer disruption at 22°C, retaining >95% vitamin C and natural red coloration.

foodSubstrates.name: Raw Apple Slices (Malus domestica - High Polyphenol Oxidase Enzymatic Browning Risk)
foodSubstrates.botanicalClass: Pome Fruit (Firm Parenchyma, High Malic Acid & Quercetin)
foodSubstrates.description: Apple rings rapidly turn dark brown under convective hot-air heat due to oxygen-activated polyphenol oxidase (PPO) enzyme kinetics. EHD drying accelerates ambient room-temperature moisture migration, minimizing thermal enzymatic browning without requiring sulfites or harsh chemical blanching pre-treatments.

foodSubstrates.name: Shiitake Mushroom Caps & Slices (Lentinula edodes - Lentinan & Eritadenine Retention)
foodSubstrates.botanicalClass: Medicinal Macrofungi (Porous Hyphal Network, High Ergosterol)
foodSubstrates.description: Medicinal mushroom polysaccharides (β-glucan lentinan) and cholesterol-lowering eritadenine hydrolyze and denature during conventional kiln drying (>65°C). EHD airflow drying maintains porous structural matrix integrity, accelerates rehydration ratio by 2.2x, and preserves intact bioactive immunomodulatory polysaccharides.

foodSubstrates.name: Probiotic Alginate Microbeads (Lactobacillus acidophilus / rhamnosus Live Cells)
foodSubstrates.botanicalClass: Functional Food Biopolymer Matrix (Micro-Encapsulated Live Culture)
foodSubstrates.description: Live probiotic bacterial cultures suffer catastrophic cellular membrane rupture and thermal denaturation if dried above 35°C (over 5-log loss in conventional hot air). EHD drying strips water vapor at 20°C with zero thermal stress, achieving >88% live cell survival (CFU/g) and shelf-stable ambient storage viability.

dischargePolarities.name: Positive DC Corona Discharge (+V)
dischargePolarities.unipolarIonDriftType: Positive Molecular Ions (N2+, O2+, H3O+ clusters)
dischargePolarities.ionicWindEfficiency: Stable, Homogeneous Glow Discharge with Uniform Velocity Profile
dischargePolarities.description: Positive corona produces a smooth, quiet Townsend glow sheath around the emitter wires. Positive ions drift toward the grounded product bed, accelerating neutral air without spark transients. Ideal for delicate food matrices where minimal ozone and maximum electrical stability are required.

dischargePolarities.name: Negative DC Corona Discharge (-V)
dischargePolarities.unipolarIonDriftType: Electrons & Negative Oxygen Ions (O2-, O-, CO3- clusters)
dischargePolarities.ionicWindEfficiency: Pulsed Trichel Regime, 25-35% Higher Peak Airflow Velocity
dischargePolarities.description: Negative corona operates via high-frequency Trichel pulses (10 kHz to 200 kHz). Emits high electron densities that impart superior momentum to ambient air, yielding higher wind speeds (up to 5.0 m/s) and faster drying rates, but generates higher ozone levels requiring catalytic scrubber integration.

dischargePolarities.name: High-Voltage Symmetrical Pulsed AC (10 kHz Square Wave)
dischargePolarities.ionicWindEfficiency: Suppressed Static Surface Charge Accumulation on Insulating Food Beds
dischargePolarities.description: High-frequency AC pulsing neutralizes static charge accumulation on insulating food slices and non-conductive conveyor belts, eliminating electrical cling and ensuring balanced bilateral ionic wind convection.

exhaustOzoneScrubbers.name: Closed-Loop Recirculating Airflow with Catalytic MnO2-CuO Honeycomb Ozone Destructor
exhaustOzoneScrubbers.oshaCompliance: Fully Compliant (Far below OSHA PEL 0.10 ppm and NIOSH 0.05 ppm)
exhaustOzoneScrubbers.description: Industrial closed-loop drying plenum. Recirculates dehumidified ambient air through high-surface-area manganese dioxide and copper oxide catalytic honeycomb blocks, converting all corona-generated ozone into diatomic oxygen (2 O3 → 3 O2) before re-entering the drying chamber.

exhaustOzoneScrubbers.name: Single-Pass Exhaust Plenum with Impregnated Activated Carbon Bed & HEPA H13
exhaustOzoneScrubbers.oshaCompliance: Fully Compliant (<0.05 ppm at exhaust discharge)
exhaustOzoneScrubbers.description: Straight-through exhaust configuration designed for wash-down food processing facilities. Captures airborne particulates and catalytic-grade carbon beds decompose ozone down to benign ambient background concentrations.

exhaustOzoneScrubbers.name: Unscrubbed Open Exhaust with Bypassed Filter Media (Ozone Leakage Hazard)
exhaustOzoneScrubbers.oshaCompliance: CRITICAL VIOLATION - Exceeds OSHA 29 CFR § 1910.1000 Ceiling (>0.50 ppm O3)
exhaustOzoneScrubbers.description: Extremely hazardous unmonitored exhaust. Corona discharge ozone escapes directly into the plant operating room, irritating workers' respiratory tracts and triggering environmental health and safety alarms.
